summary: Successfully repaired the live voice perception failure in AgenticOS/Jarvis. The camera activation now correctly returns fresh physical frame metadata (device, timestamp, dimensions, SHA-256) and vision grounding results. ActionClaimGuard enforces verification before permitting generic claims like 'I can see you'. On user correction ('that result is wrong'), the system transitions to RECOVERING state, persists the original GoalRun, invokes Hermes/Codex for diagnosis/retry, and ensures Argus re-verification against the original goal without creating unrelated tasks.
